about: Every App Review rejection of the cmux iOS app, and the detector that now catches its class before submission in the NEXT app (cmux-next-ios). cmux-next-ios/scripts/app_review_gate.py lint fails when a rejection has no detector or names one that no longer exists. Add the next rejection here the day it arrives, with its detector, in the same PR as the fix.

rejections.summary: Apple read the app as downloading or executing code
rejections.apple_said_paraphrased: Software Requirements: apps may not download, install or execute code that changes features or functionality.
rejections.root_cause: The review notes did not explain that terminal commands run on the user's Mac; the binary carried code paths that looked like local execution.

rejections.summary: Reviewer could not access the app's features without a Mac
rejections.apple_said_paraphrased: We were unable to review your app because it requires a paired device; provide a demo mode or demo hardware.
rejections.root_cause: No demonstration mode; the reviewer had no Mac.

rejections.summary: System VPN API (Network Extension packet tunnel) in the binary
rejections.apple_said_paraphrased: Your app uses the VPN API; apps offering VPN services must be published by an organization and use NEVPNManager for VPN services only.
rejections.root_cause: The CloudVPN packet tunnel extension and its entitlement shipped in the App Store binary.

rejections.summary: Scan Pairing Code did nothing (iPad, fresh install)
rejections.apple_said_paraphrased: The Scan Pairing Code button was unresponsive.
rejections.root_cause: The scanner gate swallowed the tap when Tailscale was not selected; tests used a mock that never hit that state.

rejections.summary: No way past the connect page, so the app's features were unreachable
rejections.apple_said_paraphrased: We could not locate the in-app purchases in the app.
rejections.root_cause: The connect page required a live Mac; the demonstration account hit the same gate.

rejections.summary: Support URL did not lead to support
rejections.apple_said_paraphrased: The Support URL provided in App Store Connect does not direct to a website with information users can use to ask questions and request support.
rejections.root_cause: The support URL was not checked for a working page with a contact route.
